name: Taburete alto
adaptations: Solid jequitiba (hardwood) drawn in T18 plywood
Low H stretcher and the foot rail not drawn: the legs are tied only by the apron under the seat, and no check judges how a frame on legs takes a sideways push
Width 340 and depth 290 estimated from photo proportions against the 650 height
four splayed round-edged legs drawn as four square legs that lean outward and narrow to the foot, with an apron all round
Its top is the seat: the plan says the standing use, the one that gives a top the heavy load a seat is checked with, as KC-ASI-03 does.

no stool kind: it stays a sideTable and not a bench, whose seat height (420 to 480 mm) is a dining seat's and would flag the 650 mm of a counter stool; so the seat's sag is judged as a load that stays, not as a person's
notes: Taburete alto para barra o mesa de trabajo. En Knotty queda como un taburete de triplay con asiento rectangular de esquinas rectas, cuatro patas abiertas que se adelgazan hacia el piso y un faldón bajo el asiento. No tiene travesaños entre las patas ni descansapiés: a 65 cm de alto los pies quedan colgando, y lo único que amarra las patas es el faldón.
